newsitem.title: INDIA: India to export 4,000 tonnes tea to Iran in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: India to export 4,000 tonnes tea to Iran in 96/97.

text.p: India has signed deals to export 4,000 tonnes of tea to Iran in 1996/97 (April-March), a senior industry official said on Saturday.
D.K. Ghosh, chairman of Calcutta Tea Traders' Association said Indian exporters are making efforts to increase their exports to Iran to 6,000 tonnes in the current year.
"We have already bagged contracts for exporting 4,000 tonnes of tea to Iran and we are now making efforts to increase it to 6,000 tonnes," Ghosh told reporters.
"Iran has floated tenders for buying 6,000 tonnes of tea and we are hoping to bag contracts for the remaining quantity too."
Ghosh said the deals for exporting 4,000 tonnes had recently been signed in Teheran between Iran's State Tea Organisation and five Indian exporters.

Iran had been a traditional buyer of Indian tea with annual imports of over 15,000 tonnes a year. But since 1992 it stopped buying Indian tea due to the country's severe foreign exchange crunch, he said.
"The contracts are very significant for the Indian tea industry as we have regained a lost market," Ghosh added.
